payload.core_mechanism_summary: Scans digits: if any digit is non-prime (1,4,6,8,9), outputs it. Else, uses frequency counts to find the first two-digit composite subsequence from a fixed set of pairs (e.g., 22,25,27,...).
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks the limited solution space (single non-prime digits and known two-digit composites from primes 2,3,5,7) without recursion. Among provided complete_search subtypes, search_backtracking is the closest match, though it is not true backtracking.
